🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak overall breadth (3/11) and narrow leadership with Top 5 concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow, 4/5 Technology); style: Growth/Momentum but concentration warrants caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Materials are marginally positive on the week (Healthcare 1W: +1.60%; Materials 1W: +0.71%), led by LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and select miners.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy, Utilities and Financials lag on the week (Energy 1W: -3.68%, Utilities 1W: -2.70%, Financials 1W: -1.08%). Examples: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) TREND EXHAUSTION, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND; WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION; PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) TREND EXHAUSTION — weakness concentrated in Utilities/Industrials/Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND. Watch divergences: SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — short-term bounces, not full confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is the week’s strongest sector (1W: +3.08%). Keys: AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, but ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND shows pockets of stress; overall tech strength is narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials on the week are weak (1W: -1.08%). Examples: JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND — sector under pressure, watch for further breadth deterioration.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is mildly positive (1W: +1.60%) but mixed internals. JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND — news-driven pockets of strength amid uneven breadth.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to the narrow Tech leaders (QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to weak Financials and Utilities (SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND; NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND). Style: Growth/Momentum but narrow leadership suggests being selective and monitoring reversals.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND for downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.08%) and Healthcare (1W: +1.60%) for idiosyncratic strength. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.68%) and Utilities (1W: -2.70%) where weak flows and earnings/commodity dynamics may pressure names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AAPL 1W/1M pivot: AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent breakout for continuation. NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1W support for momentum confirmation. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for follow-through above recent highs. ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — breach of short-term support would signal deeper corrective risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+90): LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — FDA approvals are confirming a short-term bounce but 1M shows incomplete trend confirmation. WBD (+85): WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — acquisition financing news confirms price strength. LRCX (+55): LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND — analyst/upside commentary aligning with price appreciation. AAPL (+50): AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND — product/AI headlines supporting continuation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-50): ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirming distribution. CHTR (-60): CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND — negative coverage matching steep sell-off. MPC (-50): MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bearish news confirms the weekly pullback vs still-positive 1M — watch for further downside.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style but leadership is narrow and concentration risk elevated. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: very limited breadth (3/11) and divergence in several large-caps (ORCL, CHTR, INTU) plus mixed news signals (LLY/MRK) — monitor for trend breaks.
